svg.title: Tasks
svg.desc: Task: bio, What it needs: A contenteditable, Graded on: Saved bio is the exact sentence; Task: theme-teal, What it needs: Shadow DOM, Graded on: Saved theme color is #0d9488; Task: iframe-notifications, What it needs: A same-origin iframe and a role=switch, Graded on: A save from the iframe with notifications off; Task: popup-report, What it needs: A target=_blank pop-up tab, Graded on: report_view logged, and the answer has the report number; Task: otp-login, What it needs: Two-step sign-in (setup {"otp": true}), Graded on: The code was accepted, and the answer has the open ticket count; Task: slow-forecast, What it needs: Waiting for late content, Graded on: The answer has the forecast; Task: captcha-handoff, What it needs: Recognizing a human-only step, Graded on: The transcript shows umbra handoff (or the MCP handoff tool). Solving the CAPTCHA without a handoff fails
